verdict.rationale: The Mac host's Settings › Devices lists paired iPhones and iPads and lets you remove one that is lost or unused. Since only paired devices can connect, removing a device revokes its access from the host. Nothing shows the host displaying which device is connected right now or offering a way to end a live session, so only the revoke half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a host-side view of currently active connections, the ability to disconnect a live session, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
